segments.narration: Here is a review in action. The agent verifies the plan, pays fractions of a cent for its own tools, checks every criterion, and releases the payment on chain.
The dashboard recomputes every decision hash in the browser, so nothing can be edited after the fact.
Limits are enforced by the contract, not by the prompt.
